verses.text: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, Thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; Thou that sittest above the cherubim, shine forth.

segments.text: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel,
Thou that leadest Joseph like a flock;
Thou that sittest
above
the cherubim, shine forth.

verses.text: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up thy might, And come to save us.

segments.text: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up thy might,
And come to save us.

verses.text: Turn us again, O God; And cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

segments.text: Turn us again, O God;
And cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

verses.text: O Jehovah God of hosts, How long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?

segments.text: O Jehovah God of hosts,
How long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?

verses.text: Thou hast fed them with the bread of tears, And given them tears to drink in large measure.

segments.text: Thou hast fed them with the bread of tears,
And given them tears to drink in large measure.

verses.text: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbors; And our enemies laugh among themselves.

segments.text: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbors;
And our enemies laugh among themselves.

verses.text: Turn us again, O God of hosts; And cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

segments.text: Turn us again, O God of hosts;
And cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

verses.text: Thou broughtest a vine out of Egypt: Thou didst drive out the nations, and plantedst it.

segments.text: Thou broughtest a vine out of Egypt:
Thou didst drive out the nations, and plantedst it.

verses.text: Thou preparedst room before it, And it took deep root, and filled the land.

segments.text: Thou preparedst
room
before it,
And it took deep root, and filled the land.

verses.text: The mountains were covered with the shadow of it, And the boughs thereof were like cedars of God.

segments.text: The mountains were covered with the shadow of it,
And the boughs thereof were
like
cedars of God.

verses.text: It sent out its branches unto the sea, And its shoots unto the River.

segments.text: It sent out its branches unto the sea,
And its shoots unto the River.

verses.text: Why hast thou broken down its walls, So that all they that pass by the way do pluck it?

segments.text: Why hast thou broken down its walls,
So that all they that pass by the way do pluck it?

verses.text: The boar out of the wood doth ravage it, And the wild beasts of the field feed on it.

segments.text: The boar out of the wood doth ravage it,
And the wild beasts of the field feed on it.

verses.text: Turn again, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: Look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine,

segments.text: Turn again, we beseech thee, O God of hosts:
Look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine,

verses.text: And the stock which thy right hand planted, And the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.

segments.text: And the stock which thy right hand planted,
And the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.

verses.text: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: They perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

segments.text: It is burned with fire, it is cut down:
They perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

verses.text: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, Upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.

segments.text: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand,
Upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.

verses.text: So shall we not go back from thee: Quicken thou us, and we will call upon thy name.

segments.text: So shall we not go back from thee:
Quicken thou us, and we will call upon thy name.

verses.text: Turn us again, O Jehovah God of hosts; Cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

segments.text: Turn us again, O Jehovah God of hosts;
Cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; set to Shoshannim Eduth. A Psalm of Asaph.
